items.author: elacordeonachi.bsky.social
items.context:
Yes yes, I'm late. This time because the Humble Choice bundle included Outer Worlds 2 and it's a game I've been looking forward to but didn't want to pay $60 to play when it came out. I've been burned before, Civ VII I'm looking at you... Anywho, we begin with recaps. #LuchaUnderground #Vundacast
quotes @vundacast.bsky.social: IT'S TIME TO RING THE BELLLLLLLL! Press Play NOW on Season 3, Episode 19, "Gods Among Men"! #Vundacast 🤼 #LuchaUnderground #WatchParty
items.text: Waiting for a bundle instead of paying $60 at launch is a solid way to play a big game. Hope Outer Worlds 2 lives up to the wait.

items.author: thoughtrise.bsky.social
items.context: trying to play Cyberpunk 2077 on my Steam Deck and it crashes as soon as I hit play (in launcher or crashes from Steam if I cmd skip the launcher) worked fine prior to the Edgerunners update. saw people complain but no solutions I can find any smart folk here with ideas? 💖
items.text: Sorry about the crash. Two things worth trying: Verify integrity of game files in Steam (Properties > Installed Files), and a different Proton version under Properties > Compatibility. Hope one of them fixes it.
